            'class _MacroRingPainter extends CustomPainter {\n'
            '  const _MacroRingPainter({\n'
            '    required this.carbs,\n'
            '    required this.fat,\n'
            '    required this.protein,\n'
            '    required this.track,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final double? carbs;\n'
            '  final double? fat;\n'
            '  final double? protein;\n'
            '  final Color track;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {\n'
            '    const colors = [Color(0xFF0A8F88), Color(0xFF6F1096), Color(0xFFFFAB32)];\n'
            '    final center = size.center(Offset.zero);\n'
            '    final radius = (size.shortestSide - 12) / 2;\n'
            '    final paint = Paint()\n'
            '      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\n'
            '      ..strokeWidth = 12\n'
            '      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.butt;\n'
            '    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius, paint..color = track);\n'
            '    if (carbs == null || fat == null || protein == null) return;\n'
            '    final energies = [carbs! * 4, fat! * 9, protein! * 4];\n'
            '    final total = energies.fold<double>(0, (sum, value) => sum + value);\n'
            '    if (total <= 0) return;\n'
            '    var start = -1.5707963267948966;\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < energies.length; i++) {\n'
            '      final sweep = 6.283185307179586 * energies[i] / total;\n'
            '      canvas.drawArc(\n'
            '        Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius),\n'
            '        start,\n'
            '        sweep,\n'
            '        false,\n'
            '        paint..color = colors[i],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      start += sweep;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _MacroRingPainter oldDelegate) =>\n'
            '      carbs != oldDelegate.carbs ||\n'
            '      fat != oldDelegate.fat ||\n'
            '      protein != oldDelegate.protein ||\n'
            '      track != oldDelegate.track;\n'
